summary: OpenTTD 是一款商业模拟游戏，玩家通过公路、铁路、水路和航空运输乘客和货物以营利。它是1995年克里斯索耶电子游戏运输大亨豪华版(Transport Tycoon Deluxe)的一个开源重制和扩展。
summaryEn: OpenTTD is a business simulation game in which players earn money by transporting passengers and cargo via road, rail, water, and air.
